mcat_description.short: Modular Portable Cabin is a factory-built, relocatable prefabricated structure assembled from steel frames and insulated sandwich panels (PUF, EPS, or glass wool), sold as a complete unit or per square foot for site offices, accommodation, security posts, and commercial use.
mcat_description.long: Modular Portable Cabins are prefabricated, relocatable structures manufactured off-site using mild steel or GI structural frames combined with insulated sandwich panels — typically PUF, EPS, or glass wool-filled — and finished with GI corrugated or ACP exterior cladding, pre-laminated interior boards, aluminium powder-coated windows, and MS or PVC doors. They are engineered for rapid on-site assembly (often within hours), easy crane-lifting, and relocation across project sites, making them the standard temporary-to-semi-permanent infrastructure solution for construction, industrial, and commercial deployments in India. The category spans a wide size range from compact 4×4 ft security cabins to multi-room 40 ft container-style offices, with options for electrical fittings, plumbing, air conditioning, and internal partitions supplied factory-fitted. Leading Indian manufacturers such as EPACK Prefab, Supersun Prefab, Epsilon Enterprise, KMS Technologies, and AR Portable Cabins build to IS-grade steel standards and ISO 9001:2015 quality systems, with pan-India delivery and installation support.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, 'Modular Portable Cabin' and 'Porta Cabin' are used interchangeably for factory-built, relocatable prefabricated structures assembled from mild steel or GI structural frames with insulated sandwich panels (PUF, EPS, or glass wool). The dominant commercial form is the construction site office cabin, followed by security guard cabins and worker accommodation units — confirmed across multiple Indian manufacturers (EPACK Prefab, KMS Technologies, Epsilon Enterprise, AR Portable Cabins). A growing sub-segment is the 'container cafe' or food kiosk cabin, which leads Google search impressions for this MCAT, indicating rising demand from F&B entrepreneurs. Rooftop/terrace room cabins are a distinct residential extension use case surfaced in both keyword data and buyer call data. Cabins are built to IS-grade steel standards (IS 2062 for structural steel, IS 1079 for sheets — referenced generically by manufacturers as 'IS standards') and ISO 9001:2015 quality systems; no single dedicated BIS standard for portable cabins was confirmed from research. Key material variants include PUF panel, EPS panel, glass wool insulated, FRP/GRP, ACP panel, and wooden/cement board constructions. Standard sizes range from 4×4 ft (compact security cabin) to 40×10 ft (large site office), with fully custom dimensions available. The Indian market is served by a fragmented base of regional manufacturers concentrated in Delhi-NCR, Pune, Bengaluru, Ahmedabad, and Vadodara, with pan-India delivery networks. Buyers typically procure direct from manufacturers; rental/hire models also exist for construction site offices (single source — low confidence).
